item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 25 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry and cold, two to six today, zero to five Thursday and Friday. You will leave the big coat on the hook to prove a point, and be cold out of principle.

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 18 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today is leg day, and the sky has not skipped it. Seven to twelve degrees, forty-six millimetres of rain, wind seven. Thursday is the second set, twenty-four millimetres. Friday is the rest day, a tenth of a millimetre, enjoy it. Saturday is the cool-down: clear, dry,…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 24 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry, cloudy and cold, two to six today and Wednesday, one to four Thursday. With no wind or rain to blame, you will blame the bus.

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 17 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today is the sale preview, and the sky has not even opened the doors. Eight to twelve degrees, five point six millimetres, wind nine. Then the clearance sale starts: Wednesday seventy-six point four millimetres, Thursday forty-three point six. A hundred and twenty…

item.description:
Weather.
Dry and cloudy today, one to five, then heavy rain Friday and a soaking Saturday, five to nine, with Sunday clear. You will hang the washing out today in pure optimism and spend Friday drying it on every radiator.

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 19 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry but cold, four to ten today and down to freezing by Saturday dawn. The clouds will look stormy and never deliver, so you will take the umbrella all three days and regret it every time.

item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry and cold, four to eight today, two to six Monday, then light rain on Tuesday. Dry today and Monday means you will announce a long walk and decide at the door that the sofa has better reviews.

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 15 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Box set weekend, and you are bingeing it whether you like it or not. Episode one, today: two to ten degrees, twenty-five point three millimetres, wind six. Episode two, Monday: four to six degrees, thirty-two point five millimetres, the wettest and coldest, naturally…

item.description:
Weather.
Today is soaking at five to ten degrees, then Sunday clears at two to ten and Monday turns cloudy at four to twelve. Today's deluge gives you permission to do nothing, Sunday's blue sky revokes it, and you will resent both.

item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry: two to eight degrees today, four to eight Sunday under cloud, two to six Monday and clear. Every dry day removes an excuse for not clearing the gutters, and you will invent a fresh one by lunchtime.

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 14 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Last orders. Today is the final dry day: minus two at dawn, up to eight, no rain, light wind. Use it or lose it. Wash the car, hang the washing, ring your mother. Because at closing time the sky buys everyone a round. Sunday, nineteen point three millimetres, wind…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 23 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The next three days are dry or nearly so and cloudy, one to six today, one to seven Tuesday, two to six Wednesday. With almost no rain forecast you will check the radar app hourly, as though it owed you money.

item.title: Briefing — Monday 16 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
The sky has spent the weekend running up a bill and today it sends the apology, in instalments. Today: two to seven degrees, twenty-six point two millimetres, wind six. Tuesday is the big grovel, thirty-eight point eight millimetres, four to twelve, the wettest day of…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 27 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Rain today at one to four degrees, then a soaking Saturday of about forty millimetres at four to eleven, before Sunday clears at four to nine. Saturday's deluge will find the one gap in your coat, and you will take it personally.

item.description:
